prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (industry, services, budget, company size, timeline, etc.). I can help find the best fit for you if you tell me a few details, but here’s a quick guide to get you started.

Quick questions
- What are your main goals? (brand awareness, leads, sales, SEO, paid ads, social, PR, etc.)
- What’s your industry? (B2B, healthcare, legal, real estate, home services, ecommerce, nonprofit…)
- Monthly budget or project budget range?
- Company size / internal marketing resources?
- Do you need local in-person support (Baltimore/Annapolis area) or is remote OK?
- Timeline / any must-have capabilities (analytics, creative, video, etc.)?

How to pick the “best” agency for you
- Relevant experience: case studies in your industry and similar goals/KPIs.
- Measurable results: tracked outcomes (leads, revenue, traffic), not just activity.
- Clear process and communication cadence.
- Transparency on pricing, reporting, and tools.
- Client references and online reviews (Clutch, Google, LinkedIn).
- Cultural fit and responsiveness (small vs. large agency vibe).

Where to look
- Directories: Clutch.co, UpCity, G2.
- Local groups / awards: Maryland Tech Council, local AMA chapters, Baltimore Business Journal lists.
- Google Maps and LinkedIn for reviews and team backgrounds.

One Maryland-based example
- Blue Corona (Gaithersburg) — known for data-driven digital marketing (SEO, PPC, analytics) and working with SMBs in home services, healthcare and other verticals. (If you want I can gather current client examples and awards for them.)

If you want, tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll shortlist 3–5 Maryland agencies tailored to your needs (with brief pros/cons, estimated costs, and suggested interview questions). Which approach would you prefer?
